from: The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate
incident_time: 12:15 2021 BAHRAIN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 March 2021 Technical Delegate's Report Last night team personnel of the Scuderia AlphaTauri Honda team, who are associated with the operation of the car, were within the confines of the circuit during the nine and a half hour period which commenced at 02:30 on 27 March, twelve and a half hours before the scheduled start time of P3 and ends three hours before the scheduled start time of P3 at 12:00 on 27 March. This was the first of the two individual exceptions permitted for the Scuderia AlphaTauri Honda team during the 2021 Formula One Championship season and therefore no action should be taken. The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate Jo Bauer
title: Curfew
